scope: Read-only Pull/Fetch default from a registered submodule parent .gitmodules when the child has no tracking branch. Partial parity; full application port remains incomplete.

libgit2_source.evidence: Pinned gitlink from TortoiseGit ls-tree; downloaded exact source inspected git_submodule_branch, submodule_read_config and gitmodules_snapshot. Display value comes from .gitmodules, not parent local override or dot expansion.

verification.core: All 17 selected tests passed: 9 Fetch (three newly added), 5 Pull and 3 FinderSubmoduleMetadata. New actual Git fixtures prove named module at Unicode/newline path, parent .gitmodules value rather than local branch override, child tracking precedence, detached HEAD default, literal dot, missing/attached fallback, byte-identical parent and child index/config on default read, unrelated registration and symlinked metadata fallback. Existing Fetch/Pull/Finder coverage also passed.
verification.native: Final headless receiver passed system Git and Git 2.37.1, 2.39.5 and bundled 2.55.0. Native Fetch and Pull models load the .gitmodules branch into selection/history. Explicit named-branch Fetch pins FETCH_HEAD without changing child HEAD/index. Pull with default NamedRemoteFetchAll=true uses the explicit submodule branch and ff-only advances to its commit while child branch main and unrelated dirty file remain. Parent .gitmodules/index/config/HEAD/branch ref bytes stay identical through load/Fetch/Pull. A child tracking override then wins on reload. Module name differs from path; path includes Unicode and LF. These are native-model/Git checks, not displayed control/screenshot acceptance.
verification.iterations: Initial four-Git native matrix passed. Expanded final receiver enables the default named-remote preference specifically for Pull, while the explicit-branch Fetch uses false; final matrix passed with unchanged production code. No runtime test failure.
verification.builds: Unsigned Debug and AppStore builds, both bundle audits and exact bundled NOTICE comparisons passed, with all 96 original icon resources. Store --require-git verified 11 universal Git Mach-O files and fixture operations; EditorConfig/IssueRegex audits passed.
verification.documentation: Pull/Fetch parity, upstream source inventory and NOTICE updated. Primary pinned libgit2 source and official Git branch-property documentation linked to distinguish display behavior from update --remote. Inventory regression and CSV column validation passed. Local site generated, unpublished.
verification.ci: Added native submodule-default receiver to macOS workflow. Hosted CI/push/site publication unverified; authentication unavailable, no retry.
verification.processes: All compiler/core/native/audit sessions terminal. No main GUI launch or displayed windows. Final app/receiver audit empty. Eight empty owned SubmoduleDefaults QA preference UUID files removed across initial/final matrices; other preferences retained.
verification.limitations: Duplicate path/name collisions, include semantics/full libgit2 cache lookup, renamed/worktree variants, parent access under signed sandbox, displayed native controls/keyboard/VoiceOver and other acceptance remain pending. Full dialog/application parity, Finder activation, genuine screenshots/full manual, signed distribution/App Store/license clearance and hosted publication remain incomplete.
